what_it_does: Systematically searches across social, technological, economic, environmental, political, cultural, and institutional change for early evidence of movement.
best_used_for: Building a broad evidence base before selecting signals or scenarios.
evidence_input: Current sources, field observations, specialist publications, participant material, counter-evidence.
kod_application: KoD Signals + Futures, field notes, annual research agenda.
caution: Scanning is collection, not interpretation. Preserve source dates and provenance.

what_it_does: Captures small, early, or unusual observations that may indicate a larger change if independently repeated.
evidence_input: Dated evidence, source diversity, explicit confidence level, contradictory evidence.
kod_application: AI, cultural roles, archives, climate adaptation, institutions.
caution: A signal is not a trend. Require repeated independent evidence before promotion.

what_it_does: Separates larger forces from local expressions and asks what is exerting pressure on the system.
best_used_for: Understanding why change may occur and what may constrain it.
evidence_input: Signals, policy, demographics, technology, capital, culture, regulation.
kod_application: Creative economy, design education, cultural institutions, cities.
caution: Do not treat macro forces as deterministic; identify local mediators.

what_it_does: Constructs multiple plausible future conditions around a question rather than assuming one forecast.
best_used_for: Testing uncertainty, institutional choices, cultural change, and alternative pathways.
evidence_input: Signals, coded findings, external research, explicit assumptions, counter-evidence.
kod_application: Future KoD research questions, cultural systems, cities, education, institutions.
caution: A scenario is not a prediction. Keep assumptions and evidence visible.

what_it_does: Uses two high-impact uncertainties to create contrasting worlds that expose different implications.
best_used_for: When uncertainty is high and a team needs more than one plausible future.
evidence_input: Two defensible uncertainties, evidence for each, scenario logic.
kod_application: Institutional strategy, future roles, education, cultural policy.
caution: Avoid choosing axes only because they produce dramatic quadrants.

what_it_does: Traces first-, second-, and third-order consequences of a change to expose indirect effects.
best_used_for: Exploring ripple effects and hidden dependencies.
evidence_input: Defined change, evidence base, participant reasoning, documented assumptions.
kod_application: AI, new cultural roles, climate, archives, public programs.

what_it_does: Uses a designed narrative, document, service, interface, or situation from a possible future to make consequences easier to examine.
best_used_for: Exploring how a future condition might feel, operate, or create new behavior.
evidence_input: Traceable evidence base plus clearly marked fictional assumptions.
kod_application: Research communication, workshops, exhibitions, publications, KoD Connect.
caution: Do not present fictional elements as observed reality.

what_it_does: Creates a tangible or visual object from a possible future so people can react to something concrete.
best_used_for: Testing values, desirability, trust, rituals, access, and institutional behavior.
evidence_input: Research question, evidence base, scenario context, intended audience.
kod_application: Objects, documents, service artifacts, future tools, exhibition pieces.
caution: The object is a research prompt, not proof that the future will happen.

what_it_does: Changes one important condition and asks what else would have to change with it.
best_used_for: Stress-testing assumptions and revealing dependencies inside a system.
evidence_input: Current-state evidence, one explicit changed condition, limits.
kod_application: Policy, cultural systems, program design, institutional models.
caution: Change one condition clearly; avoid fantasy chains with no evidence anchor.

what_it_does: Starts from a defined future condition and works backward to identify the decisions, capacities, evidence, and transitions required.
best_used_for: Turning a desired future into a sequence of testable present-day requirements.
evidence_input: Defined future condition, current baseline, constraints, milestones.
kod_application: KoD program development, research agendas, institution-building questions.
caution: The future condition must be explicit and should not be treated as inevitable.

what_it_does: Explores roles, responsibilities, skills, and tensions that could emerge under changing cultural or technological conditions.
best_used_for: Investigating new professions, institutional capabilities, and changing expertise.
evidence_input: Role signals, job data, participant evidence, sector research.
kod_application: New cultural roles, design-adjacent professions, AI, accessibility, archives.
caution: Use real evidence to ground the role; do not invent market prevalence.

what_it_does: Examines a question at multiple levels: visible issue, systems/causes, worldview, and deeper metaphor or narrative.
best_used_for: When a question is culturally loaded or repeatedly framed too narrowly.
evidence_input: Evidence at each layer; competing interpretations; explicit framing.
kod_application: Cultural identity, design education, public value, institutional narratives.
caution: Do not treat one worldview as the hidden truth; compare multiple readings.

what_it_does: Uses prototypes and acts of making as a way to generate knowledge that discussion alone may not reveal.
best_used_for: Material judgment, process knowledge, tacit knowledge, interaction, experimentation.
evidence_input: Research question, prototype log, participant reflection, observed decisions.
kod_application: Labs, workshops, material studies, cross-disciplinary experiments.
caution: Document what the making process revealed and what it did not.

what_it_does: Tests a strategy, program, role, or proposition against several scenarios to see where it holds or breaks.
evidence_input: Scenario set, explicit criteria, existing plan or proposition.
kod_application: KoD Connect, institutional models, future publication proposals.
caution: A robust option is not automatically the preferred option; values still matter.
